scenarios.description: Same 5000 alert notifications (~256 byte body), same mock server delay (10 ms), window/concurrency 100, 1 connection. One mock server per variant. Round 0 is a discarded warm-up; the order of variants rotates and alternates direction every round. pushok exposes no per-request durations, so latency is not compared.

cases.label: ours: full Sender pipeline (new pool per run)
pushok (library default: connection closed after each push())

cases.name: processed-then-dropped, once, on a reused connection
cases.setup: Request 1 (200) opens the connection; request 2 is processed by the server, which then destroys the TCP connection without answering (rule `drop`, times 1; the server answers 200 to the same request if it arrives again).

cases.name: processed-then-dropped, once, as the first request on a new connection
cases.setup: Same rule, but nothing was sent on the connection before.

cases.name: a batch of 5 where one request is always processed-then-dropped
cases.setup: Five notifications in one call; the third is processed and its connection destroyed every time it is sent.

cases.name: HTTP 503 ServiceUnavailable
cases.setup: The server answers 503 {"reason":"ServiceUnavailable"} to every request.

cases.name: HTTP 503 once, then 200
cases.setup: The first request gets 503, any later one gets 200.

cases.name: response cut in the middle of the body
cases.setup: The server sends 200 and the first half of a 2 KiB body, then destroys the connection.

curl_options.CURLOPT_PORT: mock port (pushok sets 443; user options win: `$this->curlOptions + $request->getOptions()`)
curl_options.CURLOPT_CAINFO: the mock's CA bundle (peer verification stays on)
curl_options.CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST: 0 because the mock certificate is for localhost/127.0.0.1, not api.push.apple.com. This library run therefore skips the hostname check; this package always checks it. The cost of that check is negligible next to the handshake itself, but it is a difference.
curl_options.CURLOPT_PROXY: "" (the container sets HTTPS_PROXY, pushok does not disable it)

pushok_options.library_settings: setNbConcurrentRequests(window), setMaxConcurrentConnections(connections), setAutoCloseConnections(false) for the warm variant (library default is true)
pushok_options.not_set: everything else is the library default (CURLOPT_TIMEOUT 10, HTTP/2, CURLMOPT_PIPELINING=MULTIPLEX, MAX_HOST_CONNECTIONS=connections; no CURLOPT_PIPEWAIT)
pushok_options.queueing: notifications are added with addNotification() in a loop and held in memory until push(); addNotifications() was not used because it does an in_array() scan per notification (quadratic)
